episodes.208494: Heavy rain led to river flooding along the Cache River at Patterson.
episodes.208801: A stalled front was located just off the Carolina Coast during the afternoon and early evening of November second. A low pressure system then developed along this stalled boundary and lifted north and east during the overnight hours of November second to the third with scattered showers and thunderstorms developing along the coast of Eastern North Carolina while light rain developed well inland across the Coastal Plain. With marginal values of instability and wind shear noted offshore a few isolated storms become strong to severe in nature bringing a threat for strong wind gusts to the Gulf Stream Waters between Cape Lookout and Cape Hatteras.
episodes.208991: Ahead of a cold front, a storm-force southwesterly wind gust was recorded at Minneapolis Shoal Light on the 2nd.
episodes.208992: A cold front passing over Lake Superior from the 2nd to the 4th caused storm force gusts out of the southwest ahead of the front and out of the northwest behind the front.
